<thought>Since no template directly matches both ketone and trimethylsilyl formation, I will look for a template that breaks a C‑C double bond and forms a ketone (the Peterson elimination can be represented this way). This template can be used retrosynthetically to convert the target alkene into a β‑silyl ketone precursor.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
  "molecule_smiles": "C=C(C1=CC=C(OC)C=C1)C2=CC=C(OC)C=C2",
  "functional_groups_broken": ["C-C double bonds"],
  "functional_groups_formed": ["ketones"],
  "limit": 5
}
</action_input>
